audit.whatIsWrong: K'Sante's kit was described with the wrong ability in almost every slot. Nine fields called Path Maker (W) a 'block'/'shield' that 'eats your beam and grenade' and 'blocks the grenade stun'; six called Ntofo Strikes (Q) a knockup and a dash; the shield was never attributed to Footwork (E); and the passive was called 'percent-max-HP' in four fields.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ntofo Strikes is a 450-range line strike that at 2 stacks fires a shockwave PULLING enemies in — no knockup, no dash. Path Maker is the dash: he charges up TAKING REDUCED DAMAGE, then dashes with a knockback and stun, and while All Out it no longer knocks back or stuns at all. Footwork is the dash that grants the shield. Dauntless Instinct marks targets to take more damage on his next attack — there is no percent-max-HP anywhere in the kit. Two consequences change play: damage reduction does not stop the grenade STUN (the 'block the stun' advice is mechanically impossible), and the Q shockwave PULLS, so you position to be dragged across your own turrets rather than away from them.
audit.corrected: All three abilities restated correctly across whys[0-3], whys[6], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[3], early, mid, late, wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and 'his W block resets' with no reset time.
audit.why: Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s, Ntofo Strikes a 3.5s spam, Footwork 10s, All Out 120/100/80s. The 14s on Path Maker is the window your three-turret nest actually kills in; the 3.5s Q is why he cannot poke you from outside beam range at 450.
audit.corrected: 14s, 3.5s, 450 range and 120s written into breakdown.cooldowns, early, mid, whys[2], whys[3], dosFull[0].d and report[5].

audit.why: Full and content charts agree row-for-row (Heim, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Heim, K'Sante, K'Sante) and diff/diffRating/report[14] all agree at TRICKY 7.5/10. Packet.levelChart is more Heimerdinger-favoured at rows 2-5 but the two layers are already consistent and the whys argue their own flips, so no chart edits proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was prescribed with the generic 'his healing fights your pattern' and no source named.
audit.why: All Out is the heal — Riot's text gives him 'increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities'. It arrives at 6, which is exactly when the anti-heal timing matters, and it is what refills the chip your beams put on him.
audit.corrected: All Out named as the heal in report[8] and breakdown.late, with the pre-6 timing stated.

edits.before: Level 1 you have only one turret and no stun yet, so don't get shoved off your ramp — K'Sante's Q is a short poke and his W shields the trade, so just plant a turret and farm safely. By level 2-3 a second H-28G and its slowing electron beams turn the lane into your zone: his Q-knockup needs him to step into beam range, and every CS he takes is taxed by turret DPS his W can only block for its brief active, not forever. Don't burn your CH-3X grenade as poke — hold it for the instant he dashes in so the center catches him.
edits.after: Level 1 you have only one turret and no stun yet, so don't get shoved off your ramp — Ntofo Strikes is a 450-range poke and Footwork shields him, so plant a turret and farm safely. By level 2-3 a second H-28G and its slowing electron beams turn the lane into your zone: at 450 range he must step into the beams to poke at all, and Path Maker only cuts the damage while he is charging it. Don't burn your CH-3X grenade as poke — hold it for the instant Path Maker dashes in, on a 14s cooldown, so the center catches him.

edits.before: This is your takeover. With three banked turret charges and the CH-3X center-stun online, any K'Sante all-in is suicidal — he Q-knocks-up in, you drop the grenade stun on his face, and three turrets plus Hextech Micro-Rockets delete him before his W block resets. Bait the W first: his block eats your beam and grenade, so make him spend it on a fake step-up, then commit the real combo. At 6, respect All Out R — it strips his own armor and MR but isolates you, knocks you back off your nest, and a dashless yordle is exactly what that ult hunts, so stand so the knockback throws you toward your turrets, not away from them.
edits.after: This is your takeover. With three banked turret charges and the CH-3X center-stun online, any K'Sante all-in is suicidal — he dashes in on Path Maker, you drop the grenade stun on his face, and three turrets plus Hextech Micro-Rockets delete him before its 14s returns. Bait Path Maker first: it only cuts damage while he charges it, and it stops knocking back once he is All Out, so make him spend it on a fake step-up. At 6, respect All Out R — it strips his own armor and MR but isolates you, knocks you back off your nest, and a dashless yordle is exactly what that ult hunts, so stand so the knockback throws you toward your turrets, not away from them.

edits.before: You owned this lane all game, but two-item K'Sante is a different animal — his percent-max-HP passive and stacked resists let him simply facetank the electron beams that used to zone him, and All Out R turns him into a mobile fighter who isolates you away from your nest. Your turrets don't move and you have no dash, so once he survives the beams he splits you out and one-shot windows open. Win it before ~25 minutes: snowball your level 4-5 and first-item lead into towers and tempo so his scaling never gets to cash in.
edits.after: You owned this lane all game, but two-item K'Sante is a different animal — raw HP and stacked resists let him facetank the electron beams that used to zone him, and All Out heals him through the chip while it turns him into a fighter who isolates you off your nest. Your turrets don't move and you have no dash, so once he survives the beams he splits you out and one-shot windows open. notes: The worst page in this slice. Slots were mixed up wholesale: Path Maker (W) was written as a shield/block in nine places (it is the charge-up dash with damage REDUCTION, a knockback and a stun — and it stops knocking back and stunning once he is All Out), Ntofo Strikes (Q) was written as a knockup dash in six (it is a 450-range strike whose 2-stack shockwave PULLS), Footwork (E) — the actual shield — was never named, and a 'percent-max-HP passive' that does not exist in the kit appeared four times. MECHANICAL IMPOSSIBILITY: wants.foe[0] and mid told the reader Path Maker BLOCKS the grenade stun. Damage reduction does nothing to crowd control. NOT ASSERTED: the kit flags Path Maker as true damage but Riot's text does not say so, so I left resistance advice alone — see unverified.
